# PDF.js 6.4.299 (Mozilla), vendored

Copied unchanged from the legacy build of the npm package `pdfjs-dist@6.4.299` (Apache License 2.0, see `LICENSE`). The legacy build runs in older browsers too:
`legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs`, `legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs`, `legacy/web/pdf_viewer.mjs`, `legacy/web/pdf_viewer.css`,
`legacy/web/images/`. Used by `app/js/pdfview.js` to show a passage's page with the passage highlighted.
To update: `npm pack pdfjs-dist@<version>`, copy the same files, re-run the end-to-end checks.
